description: On one dynaset over F (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; D with a time part, a repeated date and Nulls; Q x, Null, y), for each criterion [S Like 'a*' ;; S Like 'A*' ;; S Like 'a?c' ;; S Like 'a_c' ;; S Like 'a%' ;; S Like 'a#c' ;; S Like '[ab]*' ;; S Like '[!a]*' ;; S Like '[a-b]*' ;; S Like '*r*' ;; S Like '*' ;; S Like '' ;; S Like 'a*' AND N > 40 ;; S Not Like 'a*' ;; S Like "a*" ;; S Like 'O''B*' ;; S Like 'a["]b' ;; S Like 'a?b' ;; S Like '[*]' ;; Q Like '*' ;; S Like Null ;; S Like 'alpha' ;; S Like 'ALPHA' ;; N Like '4*' ;; D Like '*2020*']: FindFirst, then FindNext x2, with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks which Like wildcards (Jet and ANSI spellings, sets, ranges, negation, escapes), case rules, Null rows, and Like on number and date fields the database accepts, and the rows reached in order. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
